ImageDescription.value:
Looking towards the front of the lower deck of a Wrightbus opportunity charging (Volvo system) SRM bus. The large box on the left contains the batteries which make this an extended range hybrid which has its batteries topped-up at the route terminus.

The SRM buses are part of the New Bus For London / New Routemaster family of buses but are only 10.6m long and feature a more traditional (for London) "twin door + single staircase" format.

Another difference is that whilst the body style is NBFL / NRM the opportunity charging variant SRM uses the Volvo B5LHC chassis and a specially tweaked version of the Euro6 parallel style diesel hybrid propulsion that also allows travel in virtual electric mode.

ObjectName.value: DSCF0846 A close-up of a pile of yellow pears at a market some showing natural blemishes and stems

Categories.value: Pattaya|Files with coordinates missing SDC location of creation|Flickr images reviewed by FlickreviewR 2

ImageDescription.value: This photo shows a close-up view of yellow apples or similar fruit at what appears to be a market or grocery store. The fruits have some natural blemishes and dark spots on their yellow-golden skin, which is typical of organic or naturally grown produce. Some still have small stems attached. In the background, slightly out of focus, you can see other fruits or produce items of different colors, suggesting this is part of a larger produce display. The lighting has that characteristic indoor market brightness, creating a warm glow on the yellow fruits in the foreground while the background remains softly blurred.
